state.current_summary: The existing VisionPipelineValidator, LineFixture/Affine reference owners, normalizer, and SerializeHelper were reused. A focused graph contract proves serial, branch, Arithmetic B, fixture, and detected-point Affine references fail closed after delete, duplicate, reorder, or stale rename; explicit reference updates restore validity; XML round-trip and discarded edit clones preserve the original graph.

objective.summary: Produce deterministic evidence for Layer/Step reference invariants without adding a speculative editor or automatic reconnect layer.
constraints: Reuse existing Validator, editor/storage, normalizer, LineFixture, and Affine owners.
Do not guess or reorder references automatically.
Keep test artifacts on D: and do not modify C:\Git\2D\Original or external systems.

criteria.text: A representative serial/branch/Arithmetic B/fixture/Affine graph validates and a valid Arithmetic B route executes.
Delete, duplicate, reorder, stale Layer rename, stale fixture rename, stale branch, missing Arithmetic B, and later Affine source cases fail closed; explicit reference updates restore validity.
XML save/reopen preserves the serial, Arithmetic B, fixture, and Affine reference strings and validation outcome.
The normalizer does not silently reconnect a broken reference and discarding a mutated clone leaves the original graph valid and unchanged.
The smoke project builds in Debug and Release with zero errors, the focused contract passes in both configurations, and no Original repository or external system is mutated.
Completion evidence records the current owners, call path, mutable graph writer, binding/XML contract, reading order, focused checks, and unverified runtime/UI boundary.

context.location: VisionPipelineValidator owns admission; VisionPipelineNormalizer owns limited sequential/preprocessing normalization; VisionPipelineLineFixtureService and VisionPipelineAffinePointBindingService own typed references; RecipeCommandSurface/Recipe Manager edit and VisionPipelineStorage/SerializeHelper own persistence boundaries.

VisionPipeline.Steps and VisionPipelineStep.InputLayer/OutputLayer/Parameters are the mutable graph; Step edit/storage commands write them; Validator writes only errors/warnings; the contract mutates cloned graphs only.
Recipe Manager Step edit or XML load -> VisionPipeline model -> VisionPipelineValidator.Validate -> VisionRecipeRunner admission; reference-specific checks flow through LineFixture/Affine services.

VisionPipelineValidation.cs -> VisionPipelineLineFixtureService.cs -> VisionPipelineAffinePointBindingService.cs -> VisionPipelineNormalizer.cs -> SerializeHelper/VisionPipelineStorage.cs -> PipelineLayerReferenceInvariantContract.cs -> stable contract/current handoff.
This is a deterministic source/in-process contract. Actual WPF editor clicks, desktop EXE monitor placement, theme/DPI/keyboard matrix, camera/hardware, and physical metrology remain unverified.

artifacts.summary: Baseline and mutation XML fixtures plus the focused invariant report. Release repeat is under the sibling -release directory.

evidence.observation: Source review confirmed the existing Validator checks ordered layer availability, Arithmetic InputLayerB, typed earlier LineFixture sources, and distinct earlier Affine Point references. Display-layer rename/delete owners intentionally do not rewrite recipe routes, so no production reconnect patch was justified.

The focused contract passed in Debug and Release. Baseline and XML round-trip were valid; delete/reorder/stale rename/missing B/fixture deletion/ambiguous duplicate/later Affine source failed closed; explicit updates restored validity; normalizer did not reconnect; clone discard preserved the original; valid Arithmetic B executed.
VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug and Release builds completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors; the new invariant contract introduced no nullable warning.

The stable contract, smoke dispatch, and current handoff record the fail-closed reference policy, existing owners/call path, focused command, evidence directory, next 2D-016 boundary, and the unverified WPF/EXE/UI boundary.
